title: How to Use Instagram to Get Local Customers

segments.text: 90% of Instagram users follow at least one business. Is yours showing up?

segments.narration: Instagram has over 2 billion people using it every month. Nine out of ten of them follow at least one business. For a local shop or restaurant, that is your neighborhood on a single app waiting to find you.

segments.title: Instagram Content Reach by Format
segments.narration: Reels reach the most people, including people who have never heard of your business. Instagram pushes Reels to non-followers because it competes with TikTok. That is free local exposure for your business with every video you post.

Accounts that post every day reach 4 times more people than those posting once a week. You do not need more followers. Post Reels of your work, Stories behind the scenes, and tag your location on every single post.
See the full breakdown on setting up your profile, picking the right content types, and turning Instagram followers into actual paying customers.
